title: Show-Don't-Tell Practice
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Practice telling a general claim apart from a specific showing sentence, then write and check your own showing revision.

learningObjectives: Students will distinguish telling sentences from showing sentences and revise telling sentences into specific, concrete showing sentences.

controls: Write your own / Back to the deck button

keyQuestions: Why does piling on adjectives still count as telling?
What does a number add to a showing sentence?
Should every sentence in an essay show? Where does telling belong?
commonMisconceptions: Stronger adjectives make a claim more convincing.
Showing means adding more description, not more action.
assessmentOpportunities: Students pick the showing option on at least six of eight cards and revise one of their own telling sentences into a specific showing sentence.
